o.text:
From Proto-Turkic *keŕ- (“to walk, walk through”).
Cognates
Cognate with Turkish gezmek (“to walk”), Crimean Tatar kezmek (“to walk”), Turkmen gezmek (“to wander”), Balkan Gagauz Turkish gezinmää (“to walk”), Bashkir гиҙеү (geðiw, “to travel”), Karachay-Balkar кезик (kezik, “queue”), Kazakh кезек (kezek, “queue”), Kyrgyz кезек (kezek, “queue”), Tatar гизү (gizü, “to walk through”), Uzbek kezmoq (“to walk”).
Internationalism; via Russian режи́м (režím), from French régime, from Latin regimen.
